brief: The canvas displays an immersive visualization of an atmospheric sonar scan. The visualization begins with rhythmic pulses radiating outward from the center, mimicking echoes within the atmosphere. As these pulsations expand, they undergo a visible transformation, hardening their forms until they solidify into complex, glowing crystalline structures. These geometric patterns fill the expanse, suggesting the formation and decay of highly structured echoes. The entire process is a continuous, self-sustaining spectacle of light and defined form, requiring no interaction to view.

Starting at the center, expanding rings pulse outward with glowing intensity, their energy transforming into geometric patterns. As these pulses radiate, they solidify into intricate crystal formations that rotate and shimmer, suggesting the birth and dissolution of structured echoes within an ethereal atmosphere. The continuous animation creates a mesmerizing spectacle of light and form without any user interaction, filling the canvas with a self-sustaining display of luminous geometry.
